## Mathematical & Architectural Validation

- [ ] 100% client-side execution (vanilla JS / static HTML).
- [ ] Zero server calls, zero tracking pixels, zero cookies.
- [ ] Formula validated with worked arithmetic examples.
- [ ] Any new page includes a distinct formula, a worked example, and FAQs.
- [ ] Accessible semantics (`<main>`, `<label>`, `<button>`, `<input>`).
- [ ] Mobile responsive layout verified.
- [ ] Canonical URL and meta tags properly formatted.
- [ ] Reciprocal `hreflang` declared if internationalizing.
- [ ] No duplicate doorway copy or unverified claims.

## Test Verification

- [ ] `npm test` passed locally with 0 errors.
